summary.text: Susan McLain is a Democratic state representative from District 29 who has represented the district since January 12, 2015 and is seeking re-election.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Susan McLain said her roots in western Washington County are deep: she raised her family in Forest Grove, taught in Hillsboro, and attends church in Cornelius.
She described her experience as 42 years as a classroom teacher, 16 years as a Metro councilor and 11 years as a state representative.
McLain was assigned to the Agriculture and Land Use, Joint Interstate 5 Bridge (co-chair), Joint Transportation (co-chair) and Joint Ways and Means committees in the 2023-2024 session.
In the survey she said she chairs the House Transportation Committee and serves on the Joint Ways and Means Subcommittee on Education.

She listed her campaign messages as fighting federal overreach and protecting immigrant communities, high-quality public education, and safe and modern infrastructure, and said she is passionate about education, transportation and land use.
